# PR Checklist

- [ ] Scope is one logical change.
- [ ] Active phase/backlog item linked.
- [ ] No model/output/private data committed.
- [ ] Error and interrupt paths handled.
- [ ] State leakage considered.
- [ ] Stock UI impact considered.
- [ ] Tests added/run.
- [ ] Performance evidence uses same-session A/B where claimed.
- [ ] Feature flag/fallback exists for risky behavior.
- [ ] Patch inventory updated for Neo core edits.
- [ ] Documentation and project state updated.
- [ ] Independent review requested for CUDA/model-lifecycle changes.
